game.title: Super Mario 3D World
game.notes: Genesis Mode — this list targets the original 2013 Nintendo Wii U release specifically, WITHOUT the 2021 Switch 'Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury' additions (no Bowser's Fury campaign, no online multiplayer, no amiibo support of any kind). Two initial scope assumptions were corrected during scouting: Toad has always been playable on Wii U (it is Toadette who has never been playable in any version), and the Koopalings do not appear in this game at all — its bosses are original/returning characters (Boom Boom, Pom Pom, Hisstocrat, Boss Brolder, King Ka-thunk, Prince Bully, Motley Bossblob) plus three Bowser fights. Several disputed dossier facts were deliberately left unquantified to avoid Rule 1/2 violations: the exact total course count (116 vs. 117 across sources), exact Green Star/Stamp/gold-flag thresholds to unlock post-game worlds, and whether a single aggregate collectible counter exists anywhere — full-collection trophies instead verify against the World Map/Course List per-level state and the save-file's own 5-star completion rating, which is a real, directly-displayed in-game system. The full list of secret exits could not be confirmed beyond two known examples, so 'Shortcut!' only requires finding one, not all. The Miiverse Stamp-posting feature is permanently non-functional since Miiverse's 2017 shutdown and is not referenced by any trophy; Stamps themselves remain fully collectible and trackable. No DLC was ever released for the Wii U version.

trophies.name: Star Struck
trophies.description: Collect your first Green Star.
trophies.verification: The Green Star is confirmed collected on the course's results screen and marked on the World Map course icon.

trophies.name: Here Kitty, Kitty
trophies.description: Transform into Cat form using a Super Bell for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Cat Suit transformation and its abilities become active immediately after grabbing the Super Bell.

trophies.name: Road Trip Rumble
trophies.description: Defeat Bowser at Bowser's Highway Showdown in World 1.
trophies.verification: Bowser's defeat triggers the course-clear cutscene, and World 2 becomes accessible on the World Map.

trophies.name: Copy That
trophies.description: Create clones of yourself using a Double Cherry for the first time.
trophies.verification: Multiple copies of your character appear on screen immediately after grabbing the Double Cherry.

trophies.name: Boom, Boom, Out Go the Lights
trophies.description: Defeat Boom Boom for the first time.
trophies.verification: Boom Boom's defeat triggers the tank course's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Mystery Solved
trophies.description: Clear a Mystery House course for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Mystery House course is marked cleared on the World Map.

trophies.name: Shortcut!
trophies.description: Find a secret exit for the first time.
trophies.verification: A new path opens on the World Map, connecting to a world or course not normally reachable in sequence.

trophies.name: Lucky Toad
trophies.description: Receive the bundle of four power-ups from a Toad House.
trophies.verification: Four power-up icons are added to your item stock immediately after opening the Toad House box.

trophies.name: The Gang's All Here
trophies.description: Clear a course together with at least one other player in local co-op.
trophies.verification: The course-clear results screen displays multiple players' scores for that playthrough.

trophies.name: Pom Pom, Popped
trophies.description: Defeat Pom Pom at The Bullet Bill Express.
trophies.verification: Pom Pom's defeat triggers the course-clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Banquet Crashed
trophies.description: Defeat Hisstocrat at A Banquet with Hisstocrat.
trophies.verification: Hisstocrat's defeat triggers the course-clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Rock Bottom
trophies.description: Defeat Boss Brolder at Lava Rock Lair.
trophies.verification: Boss Brolder's defeat triggers the course-clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Thunderstruck
trophies.description: Defeat King Ka-thunk at King Ka-thunk's Castle.
trophies.verification: King Ka-thunk's defeat triggers the course-clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Bully Beatdown
trophies.description: Defeat Prince Bully at Prince Bully Blockade.
trophies.verification: Prince Bully's defeat triggers the course-clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Blob Squad
trophies.description: Defeat Motley Bossblob to clear World 6.
trophies.verification: Motley Bossblob's defeat triggers the course-clear cutscene, and World Castle becomes accessible on the World Map.

trophies.name: Written in the Stars
trophies.description: Unlock Rosalina as a playable character by clearing Super Galaxy in World Star.
trophies.verification: Rosalina appears as a selectable character on the character-select screen before entering a course.

trophies.name: Flying Colors
trophies.description: Touch the very top of the Goal Pole in every course in the game.
trophies.verification: Every course shows a gold flag icon on the World Map, and the corresponding star is earned on the save-file select screen.

trophies.name: Puzzle Master
trophies.description: Clear every Captain Toad puzzle course.
trophies.verification: Every Captain Toad course is marked cleared on the World Map.

trophies.name: Keeper of the Keep
trophies.description: Defeat Bowser at Bowser's Lava Lake Keep, rescuing the final Sprixie Princess.
trophies.verification: Bowser's defeat triggers the cutscene rescuing the final Sprixie Princess, and World Bowser becomes accessible on the World Map.

trophies.name: Meowser Mash
trophies.description: Defeat Bowser's final form atop The Great Tower of Bowser Land.
trophies.verification: The ending cutscene plays and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Stellar Collector
trophies.description: Collect every Green Star in the game.
trophies.verification: Every course shows a full Green Star count on the World Map, and the corresponding star is earned on the save-file select screen.

trophies.name: Stamp Collector
trophies.description: Collect every Stamp in the game.
trophies.verification: Every course with a Stamp shows it collected on the World Map, and the corresponding star is earned on the save-file select screen.

trophies.name: One for All
trophies.description: Clear every course in the game with all five playable characters.
trophies.verification: The corresponding star is earned on the save-file select screen, confirming every course has been cleared by all five characters.

trophies.name: Champion's Road
trophies.description: Clear Champion's Road, the final and hardest course in World Crown.
trophies.verification: The course-clear results screen appears for Champion's Road.

trophies.name: Perfect Performance
trophies.description: Earn a full five-star save file with every star in its sparkling state. If the Invincibility Leaf is ever used, the sparkle can be restored by re-clearing the affected course(s) without it.
trophies.verification: All five stars on the save-file select screen appear in their sparkling state.

trophies.name: Sprixie Kingdom's Savior
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.
